wave_description: Push the harness-agnostic paper-skill corpus toward 500 entries. This batch adds 45 PSP / Solar Orbiter / Helios / inner-heliosphere paper-skills not previously covered.
generator: HelioSI paper-to-skill factory (v0.2) — wave500 inner-heliosphere PSP/SolO batch #045

runtime_neutrality.principle: Paper-skills are harness-agnostic. LingTai, Claude Code, Codex, MCP servers, and notebook-driven workflows are adapters, not assumptions in the skill body.
skill_layers: 2. Scientific invariant layer (claims, equations, data assumptions, failure modes, figure targets)
3. Executable protocol layer with abstract capability contracts (C-FETCH-*, C-CLASSIFIER, C-METRIC)
4. Adapter / runtime notes (optional examples only — never authoritative)
5. Research-generation affordance (gaps, tensions, hypotheses, minimal experiments)

compilation_framing.model: Each paper is compiled into a runtime-neutral paper-skill describing capability contracts and scientific invariants; no MCP / plugin / harness names appear in the contract layer.

mapping.methods_equations: executable procedure stated against capability contracts

scope.focus: PSP / Solar Orbiter / Helios / inner-heliosphere observations, switchbacks, magnetic structures, alignments, near-Sun phenomena.
deliberate_exclusions: No skills duplicating existing slugs in batches batch_psp_switchbacks_magnetic, batch_mission_instruments_data_products, batch_pfss_source_mapping, batch_solar_wind_segmentation_ml, batch_sep_energetic_particles, batch_turbulence_heating_apj, batch_heliophysics_software_infrastructure, pilot_2026_and_runtime, pilot_turbulence.
No invented identifiers — DOIs/arXiv IDs/ADS bibcodes are either lifted from local inventories or set to TODO_verify_with_full_text.
No full-text reproductions in this batch — quality tier is 'paper-grounded-pending-full-text' across all 45 skills.

skills.title: What are Switchbacks?

research_generation_affordances.statement: Geometric interpretation vs. funnel-origin (Bale 2021) — both can be true simultaneously; mixture model needed.
Apply the solitary-wave virtual-sampling method to PSP E10–E16 to test whether 1D B-magnitude flatness predicts switchback geometry class.

skills.title: Mixed Source Region Signatures Inside Magnetic Switchback Patches Inferred by Heavy Ion Diagnostics

research_generation_affordances.statement: Composition heterogeneity inside patches challenges single-funnel origin assumption from Bale 2021.
No sibling skill quantifies the heavy-ion contrast threshold above which two patches are 'different sources'.

skills.title: Strong Prevalence of Hammerhead Velocity Distributions Close to the Heliospheric Current Sheet

research_generation_affordances.statement: No skill yet links hammerhead VDF prevalence to upstream/downstream wave activity in the same window.
Cross-correlate hammerhead-VDF detections with ion-cyclotron wave detections (Verniero 2020) on the same intervals.

skills.title: Parker Solar Probe Observations of Compound Reconnection Exhaust Boundaries and Mirror-Mode Structures in the Near-Sun Heliospheric Current Sheet

research_generation_affordances.statement: Compound slow-shock + mirror-mode boundaries are common near the Sun but disappear by 0.3 au; testable on PSP E14–E20.
Apply Walén + R–H tests on all flagged HCS crossings in PSP E14–E20 burst windows.

skills.title: Observation of Large-Scale Kelvin-Helmholtz Instability Wave Driven by a Coronal Mass Ejection

research_generation_affordances.statement: No companion in-situ KHI skill at inner heliosphere; PSP/SolO flank crossings could be searched.
Search PSP MAG/SWA for KH-like B/v oscillations on the flank of catalogued CMEs (CDPP).

skills.title: Free Energy Sources of Ion-scale Waves Observed by Parker Solar Probe

research_generation_affordances.statement: Left-handed-wave fraction's radial increase reflects rising parallel beam drift — testable on E14–E20.
No skill yet quantifies the wave-particle heating rate from this LH-wave population.

skills.title: How the Oblique Drift Instability Alters Solar Wind Heating and Constrains the Distribution of Solar Wind Observations

research_generation_affordances.statement: Oblique drift threshold may overlap with parallel-firehose threshold in low-β slow wind; competing instability attribution.
Compute both threshold contours on the same PSP low-β interval set and report which dominates by encounter.

skills.title: On the magnetic field evolution of interplanetary coronal mass ejections from 0.07 to 5.4 au

research_generation_affordances.statement: No sibling skill currently quantifies how ICME radial scaling depends on solar-cycle phase.
Restrict the fit to cycle-23 and cycle-24 maxima separately and compare exponents.

skills.title: Whistler waves in the young solar wind: statistics of amplitude and propagation direction from Parker Solar Probe Encounters 1-11

research_generation_affordances.statement: Counter-streaming whistler power should scale with strahl deficit — testable on encounters with strahl + whistler statistics jointly.
No companion skill maps the corresponding outer-heliospheric whistler statistic; cross-mission extension proposed.

skills.title: Propagation of untwisting solar jets from the low-beta corona into the super-Alfvénic wind: Testing a solar origin scenario for switchbacks

research_generation_affordances.statement: Jet-origin (this work) vs in-situ turbulence-origin (Shoda 2021) — joint observables (delta-B alignment + spherical-polarisation) needed.
Run synthetic-spacecraft sampling of jet output at multiple impact parameters; compare delta-B vs spherical-polarisation to PSP catalog.

skills.title: Characteristics and Source Regions of Slow Alfvenic Solar Wind Observed by Parker Solar Probe

research_generation_affordances.statement: No skill maps the heavy-ion contrast inside SASW intervals to the same dual-source picture.
If low-B0 SASW dominates at solar minimum, fraction should drop at solar max — testable using late-mission PSP encounters.

skills.title: Properties of Steady Sub-Alfvénic Solar Wind in Comparison with Super-Alfvénic Wind from Measurements of Parker Solar Probe

research_generation_affordances.statement: Switchback suppression in sub-Alfvénic intervals (this paper) vs presence of small-amplitude deflections in Adhikari 2026 — definition of 'switchback' affects the disagreement.
Apply uniform amplitude threshold to both papers' interval lists and recount.

skills.title: Constraints on the Alfvénicity of Switchbacks

research_generation_affordances.statement: Non-Alfvenic excess at large deflection is the signature of reconnection-driven boundaries leaking inward into the event interior.
Stack PSP switchbacks by deflection-angle bin and compare delta-v residuals near vs far from documented reconnection-exhaust boundaries.

skills.title: Properties of an interplanetary shock observed at 0.07 and 0.7 Astronomical Units by Parker Solar Probe and Solar Orbiter

research_generation_affordances.statement: No systematic catalog yet of dual-spacecraft shock observations under PSP–SolO radial alignment.
Build a multi-event catalog of PSP–SolO aligned shocks and fit radial evolution per shock class.

skills.title: A Detailed Analysis of a Magnetic Island Observed by WISPR on Parker Solar Probe

research_generation_affordances.statement: No skill systematically pairs WISPR magnetic-island imaging with downstream PSP in-situ flux-rope catalog.
For each WISPR-imaged structure, search PSP MAG/SWEAP for the corresponding in-situ flux-rope crossing.

skills.title: Characterization of the Trans-Alfvénic Region Using Observations from Parker Solar Probe

research_generation_affordances.statement: No sibling skill measures the perpendicular-cascade timescale ratio sub/super-Alfvenic.
If anisotropy contrast scales with M_A, then trans-Alfvenic boundary acts as a filter on perpendicular cascade — testable via structure-function method.

skills.title: Evidence for an Inverse Cascade of Magnetic Helicity in the Inner Heliosphere

research_generation_affordances.statement: Inverse cascade signature contrasts with forward-cascade turbulent-heating picture (Bandyopadhyay 2020) — both can coexist if scales are separate.
Joint reduced-helicity + cascade-rate analysis on PSP E10 perihelion interval; check whether scale separation is real.

skills.title: Angular dependence of third-order law in anisotropic MHD turbulence

research_generation_affordances.statement: Re-run Bandyopadhyay 2020 ε computation conditioning on flow-direction-vs-B angle; check 60° optimum holds.
Cascade-rate enhancement near the Sun is partly a sampling-angle artifact when sampling becomes radial-aligned at perihelion.

skills.title: Mode Composition Shapes Magnetic Anisotropy in Solar Wind Turbulence

research_generation_affordances.statement: Parallel-mode concentration of slow/fast should explain spectral-break angular dependence — testable on PSP angle-conditioned spectra.
No sibling skill applies kinetic-eigenmode decomposition (KAW, ICW) consistently to inner-heliosphere data.

skills.title: Sub-ion scale current sheets in kinetic Alfvén wave turbulence

research_generation_affordances.statement: Sub-ion current-sheet fraction (PVI > τ at sub-ion lag) increases inward — testable on PSP near-Sun burst MAG.
Compute PVI at fixed sub-ion lag (~ρ_p) across PSP E1–E20; compare to PIC distribution shape.

skills.title: The Nature of Turbulence at Sub-Electron Scales in the Solar Wind

research_generation_affordances.statement: If electrostatic dominance is universal at sub-ρ_e, then magnetic-spectrum index becomes a poor probe of electron heating — needs cross-check with electron-temperature gradient.
No paper-skill yet links sub-electron density spectrum to electron heating-rate budget.

skills.title: Dynamical Age of Alfvénic Turbulence in the Solar Wind

research_generation_affordances.statement: No sibling skill measures the same age parameter using high-cadence kinetic-range correlation lengths.
Compute turbulence age on aligned PSP–SolO conjunction intervals; check radial trend within a single source.

skills.title: MMS Insights into CME Driven Sub-Alfvénic Solar Wind at 1 AU

research_generation_affordances.statement: Sub-Alfvénic σ_c at 1 au (≈0) contrasts with PSP near-Sun sub-Alfvénic σ_c (non-trivial) — radial vs context-driven difference.
Restrict σ_c statistics to PSP sub-Alfvénic intervals inside vs outside ICME context; compare.

skills.title: Characterization of compressible fluctuations in solar wind streams dominated by balanced and imbalanced turbulence

research_generation_affordances.statement: No skill quantifies the imbalance threshold above which slow-mode heating dominates Alfvénic heating near the Sun.
If slow-mode heating dominates the imbalanced near-Sun fraction, electron-vs-proton heating ratio should track imbalance — testable with PSP electron moments.

skills.title: Solar Wind Heating Near the Sun: A Radial Evolution Approach

research_generation_affordances.statement: Free-energy budget exceeds beam-generation cost by factor F(r); F should saturate near sub-Alfvenic transition.
Compute F(r) per encounter; check saturation near M_A → 1.

skills.title: Radial evolution of Alfvén wave Parametric Decay Instability in the near-Sun solar wind: Effects of Temperature Anisotropy

research_generation_affordances.statement: PDI enhancement by anisotropy explains observed compressible-fluctuation rise near the Sun (Gonzalez 2026) — testable via correlation of T_perp/T_par with slow-mode amplitude.
Bin PSP intervals by T_perp/T_par and check slow-mode amplitude correlation.

skills.title: Magnetic switchback formation: a review of proposed mechanisms

research_generation_affordances.statement: Review identifies untested joint observables (delta-B vs spherical-polarisation vs heavy-ion contrast) — no current skill computes the full triplet on a single interval.
On a PSP–SolO lineup interval (P11), compute the joint (delta-B alignment, spherical-polarisation, Q_Fe contrast) triplet and locate each switchback in the discriminating matrix.

skills.title: Residual energy of magnetohydrodynamic shocks

research_generation_affordances.statement: Residual-energy step magnitude should correlate with shock Mach number — testable on dual-spacecraft catalog.
No paper-skill yet computes residual-energy steps on the PSP perihelion shock subset.

skills.title: Local proton heating at magnetic discontinuities in Alfvénic and non-Alfvénic solar wind

research_generation_affordances.statement: Heating-channel split tracks σ_c continuously, not via a single Alfvenic/non-Alfvenic dichotomy.
Re-bin PSP intervals by continuous σ_c quartiles and measure conditional T-jump at discontinuities.

skills.title: Solar wind data analysis aided by synthetic modeling: a better understanding of plasma-frame variations from temporal data

research_generation_affordances.statement: No skill compares model-corrected plasma-frame spectra to ML-inferred (Bloch-style) classifications.
Apply the toolkit to a PSP–SolO conjunction interval and check that corrected spectra match across spacecraft.

skills.title: Helios mission archival reanalysis: cross-check of PSP turbulence radial scaling against the 0.3–1.0 au Helios baseline

research_generation_affordances.statement: No paper-skill currently rehouses Helios in modern PSP-style local-mean-field structure functions on a unified slug.
Apply the Sioulas 2022 PVI / structure-function pipeline to Helios E1 merged data on a 0.3-au shell and check kurtosis-scaling consistency with PSP-derived trends.

skills.title: Stochastic Heating in the Sub-Alfvénic Solar Wind

research_generation_affordances.statement: Stochastic-heating rate should peak just inside Alfvén surface and drop deeper sub-Alfvenic.
Apply the diagnostic on a continuous E14 sub-Alfvenic crossing and bin by depth (1 − M_A).

skills.title: Switchback Deflections Beyond the Early Parker Solar Probe Encounters

research_generation_affordances.statement: No skill extends this trend through E20 with a consistent classifier.
Apply Schwadron classifier verbatim to PSP E9–E20; report radial trend continuity.

skills.title: Anisotropy of Magnetic Field Spectra at Kinetic Scales of Solar Wind Turbulence as Revealed by Parker Solar Probe in the Inner Heliosphere

research_generation_affordances.statement: Angle-dependent break may bias single-direction inertial-range slope claims.
Re-do Huang 2023 1/f spectral fit conditioned on flow-angle bin and check slope robustness.

skills.title: Anisotropic Magnetic Turbulence in the Inner Heliosphere — Radial Evolution of Distributions Observed by Parker Solar Probe

research_generation_affordances.statement: No skill links distributional shape to source-region class via PFSS mapping.
Distribution skewness should peak at the streamer-belt / coronal-hole boundary radial bin.

skills.title: Scaling Anisotropy with Stationary Background Field in the Near-Sun Solar Wind Turbulence

research_generation_affordances.statement: Stationarity-conditioned anisotropy slopes differ from unconditioned estimates (Sioulas 2023) — methodological comparison needed.
Run both methods on the same intervals and report slope deltas with statistical error bars.

skills.title: Proton and Alpha Driven Instabilities in an Ion Cyclotron Wave Event

research_generation_affordances.statement: Single-event study; no skill maps proton vs alpha contribution across many ICW events.
Apply the same multi-species solver to the Shankarappa 2025 LH-wave event catalog.

research_generation_affordances.statement: Plasma-frame-corrected slopes differ from spacecraft-frame slopes — re-check Huang 2023 1/f scaling.

skills.title: The relation between magnetic switchbacks and turbulence in the inner heliosphere

research_generation_affordances.statement: Switchback-turbulence coupling sign depends on patch definition — Shoda 2021 generation hypothesis predicts one sign; Bale 2021 funnel-origin predicts another.
Apply both patch classifiers and compare conditional-spectrum delta-α sign.

skills.title: Emergence of two inertial sub-ranges in solar wind turbulence

research_generation_affordances.statement: Sub-range breakpoint should track Alfven correlation length — testable on radial-aligned PSP–SolO conjunctions.
Re-fit PSD on E10 (0.07 au) with two-segment model; compare breakpoint to expected correlation-length value.
